message:
test(standby): an older host's silence against the product's lease and runner -- the pure stand-in for the --old-host cases not run here (test-injection-finding r5, Codex Finding-3 (4))

A loopback socket that does what a pre-standby host does with the standby kinds: nothing (an unknown kind is
dropped) -- no answer, no "Unsupported" (no such thing on the old wire); it records what it receives. Against it,
the product's StandbyLease / StandbyRunner: exactly kHelloAttempts StandbyHellos, then Unsupported and nothing more;
no activation arguments, no Activate, no ordinary Hello; a release while admitting stops at once; the runner's status
Unsupported (the app's tap then goes the ordinary way: StandbyKeep.onTap(UNSUPPORTED) == Cold(releaseFirst),
StandbyKeepTest.kt) and TakeActivation refuses. 13/13. Not a run of the published 0.2.163 host, not a recovery of any
withheld EVIDENCE.
